questions.prompt: During the melting of ice at 0 °C, the temperature of the mixture stays constant because the supplied heat:

questions.explanation: The energy supplied during melting is the latent heat of fusion; it breaks the attractions holding the particles in a fixed lattice rather than raising their average kinetic energy, so the temperature does not change.
